meta.title: NeoGrid — studio credentials 2026
meta.description: Credentials for NeoGrid, a Rotterdam identity-systems studio: grids before moodboards, three measured cases (transit signs, a SaaS design system, a festival), clients and a 10-week sprint.

slides.heading: We build identity systems that still work in year five.
slides.lead: Grids, type and rules your own team can run without us.
slides.notes: Year five is the promise. Every case in this deck is measured after launch, not at launch.

slides.heading: Every brand we ship starts as a grid, not a moodboard
slides.lead: If a new designer can't build a page from the rules, the system failed.

cards.title: One grid, every format
cards.body: Poster, app and signage share one grid.

slides.heading: TramGent's new stop signs cut missed-stop complaints by 38%
slides.lead: 1,140 signs on one grid. Line numbers grew from 40 mm to 120 mm.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 1600 400'><rect width='1600' height='400' fill='%230A0A0A'/><rect x='700' y='40' width='820' height='250' fill='%23F5F4EF'/><rect x='700' y='40' width='250' height='250' fill='%23E6FF3D'/><text x='825' y='230' font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-weight='bold' font-size='200' fill='%230A0A0A' text-anchor='middle'>4</text><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' fill='%230A0A0A'><text x='980' y='110' font-size='54' font-weight='bold'>KORENMARKT</text><text x='980' y='160' font-size='30'>→ Gent-Sint-Pieters · 6 min</text><rect x='980' y='190' width='500' height='4'/><text x='980' y='245' font-size='30'>Next: 2 · 9 · 14 min</text></g><text x='560' y='120' font-family='Courier,monospace' font-size='22' fill='%23E6FF3D'>120 mm</text><path d='M660 50 V280' stroke='%23E6FF3D' stroke-width='3'/></svg>
slides.imageAlt: A TramGent stop sign: a lemon panel with a giant line number 4 at 120 mm, the stop name Korenmarkt, the direction and the next three departures.
slides.notes: Hold here. The 120 mm line number is the whole idea: you can read it from the tram door.

slides.heading: TramGent replaced 1,140 signs five weeks early and under budget

slides.heading: Quanta's design system replaced 380 one-off parts with 46 components
slides.body:
We rebuilt 212 screens on one 8-px grid.
The in-house team owns it now.

slides.lead: Median days from spec to shipped screen. Source: Quanta issue tracker, n = 312 screens.

slides.heading: Noordzee Jazz sold out three days early with one poster grid
slides.lead: 62 artist posters from one rule set. Ticket sales up 27% on 2025.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 -20 1600 400'><rect y='-20' width='1600' height='420' fill='%23ECECE8'/><g stroke='%230A0A0A' stroke-width='4' font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-weight='bold'><rect x='640' y='40' width='200' height='220' fill='%23E6FF3D'/><rect x='870' y='40' width='200' height='220' fill='%230A0A0A'/><rect x='1100' y='40' width='200' height='220' fill='%23F5F4EF'/><rect x='1330' y='40' width='200' height='220' fill='%23E6FF3D'/></g><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-weight='bold' font-size='40'><text x='656' y='100' fill='%230A0A0A'>NZJ</text><text x='886' y='100' fill='%23E6FF3D'>NZJ</text><text x='1116' y='100' fill='%230A0A0A'>NZJ</text><text x='1346' y='100' fill='%230A0A0A'>NZJ</text></g><g font-family='Helvetica,Arial' font-size='26'><text x='656' y='160' fill='%230A0A0A'>AMA KOI</text><text x='886' y='160' fill='%23F5F4EF'>THE DUNES</text><text x='1116' y='160' fill='%230A0A0A'>LIV OKAFOR</text><text x='1346' y='160' fill='%230A0A0A'>TRIO ZOUT</text></g><g font-family='Courier,monospace' font-size='18'><text x='656' y='196' fill='%230A0A0A'>FRI 18 JUL</text><text x='886' y='196' fill='%23E6FF3D'>SAT 19 JUL</text><text x='1116' y='196' fill='%230A0A0A'>SAT 19 JUL</text><text x='1346' y='196' fill='%230A0A0A'>SUN 20 JUL</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Four Noordzee Jazz artist posters side by side, each built on the same grid: NZJ mark top left, artist name and date in fixed positions, lemon, black and putty colourways.

slides.quote: Two years on, our in-house team still hasn't broken the grid. That has never happened to us before.
slides.by: Sanne de Vries, Head of Brand, Quanta

slides.heading: Every identity runs as a 10-week sprint that ends in a stranger test
slides.notes: The stranger test is the sales point: we hand the rulebook to a designer who has never seen the brand.

slides.heading: Brief us once, then run the system for years
slides.lead: Send one page about your brand. We reply within two working days.
